# Text

<!-- agent-docs:start (generated by eacp-agent-docs; edits here are overwritten) -->

## Headers

- [Bidi.h](Bidi.h): The Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm, UAX #9, as portable code: it turns a paragraph of logically ordered text into embedding levels and from those into the visual order a shaper is to place runs in. (declares `BidiBaseDirection`, `BidiLevels`, `bidiLevels`, `bidiVisualOrder`, `BidiRun`, `bidiRuns`, `isLeftToRightOnly`, `bidiMirroredAt`)
- [Common.h](Common.h)
- [Font.h](Font.h): The four faces a code editor or terminal actually switches between mid-line. (declares `FontStyle`, `toFontStyle`, `isBold`, `isItalic`, `FontVariant`, `wantsSyntheticItalic`, `withholdsSyntheticItalic`, `variantOf`, `styleOf`, `weightClass`, `faceKeyOf`, `defaultMonospaceFamily`, `FontRequest`, `Font`, `sameFace`, `FontMetrics`)
- [GlyphAtlas.h](GlyphAtlas.h): Where a cached glyph lives and how to place it. (declares `GlyphSlot`, `ShapedSlot`, `ShapedText`, `GlyphAtlas`, `rasterizerFaceFactory`)
- [GlyphBitmap.h](GlyphBitmap.h): One rasterized glyph, before it goes into an atlas. (declares `GlyphFormat`, `bytesPerPixel`, `GlyphBitmap`)
- [GlyphRasterizer.h](GlyphRasterizer.h): A glyph as a shaper names it: its index in a font's own table, and which font that is. (declares `GlyphKey`, `ShapedGlyph`, `ShapedRun`, `RasterRequest`, `GlyphSource`, `GlyphRasterizer`, `RegisteredFont`, `registerMemoryFont`)
- [GlyphRenderer.h](GlyphRenderer.h): One glyph to draw. (declares `GlyphInstance`, `GlyphRenderer`)
- [ShelfPacker.h](ShelfPacker.h): declares `PackedRect`, `ShelfPacker`
- [Text.h](Text.h): umbrella header: includes 9 headers
- [TextRenderer.h](TextRenderer.h): One glyph a layout placed: its pen in the caller's own points, and which glyph of which face to draw there. (declares `PlacedGlyph`, `SnappedPen`, `snapPen`, `TextRenderer`)
- [UnicodeBidi.h](UnicodeBidi.h): The Bidi_Class property values, named as UAX #9 abbreviates them: the strong and weak types, the neutrals, and the explicit formatting characters - embeddings and overrides, which X9 removes, and isolates, which it keeps. (declares `BidiClass`, `BidiBracketType`, `ClassRange`, `MirrorPair`, `BracketPair`, `bidiClassOf`, `bidiMirroredGlyph`, `bidiBracketOf`, `bidiCanonicalBracket`)
- [UnicodeEmoji.h](UnicodeEmoji.h): The Unicode Emoji_Presentation property (UTS #51), from emoji-data.txt of Unicode 16.0 (Emoji 16.0), as sorted, merged, inclusive ranges. (declares `EmojiRange`, `hasEmojiPresentation`, `wantsEmojiPresentation`)
- [Utf8.h](Utf8.h): Writes `codepoint` as UTF-8 into `into`, which holds at least four bytes, and returns how many it used. (declares `encodeUtf8`, `decodeUtf8`)
